items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: There is a thing that even Mr. Bennie Moten had that I used to remember. They had Bus Moten, they had Basie jumping up and down

ctx.x: That's right. A whole note gets four beats, a half note gets two, a quarter note gets one. There are four beats in the measure. We don't go with the joggin', time or money. Give each note its value, Little Bo-Peep,,the sheep it will follow. Just give a note its value, but we sit and we didn't go north, south, east, and west. We played as one. But what made us play as one, the kind of lives that we had lived as human beings, the elbows that we had touched out and reached. We brought that on the bandstand and we…
Bus Moten, what does he play?
He played the accordion and piano.
